A USEFUL STARTING POINT

A few details
go a long way.

  • Your postcode and the kind of work you need.
  • For a bathroom: what you want to change and any preferred timing.
  • For a repair: what is happening and when it started.
  • Photos of the room or fitting, if you have them.

If Connor is working and cannot answer, send a text with your details.

Availability is confirmed directly. For a suspected gas emergency, use official emergency guidance.
